endorsements.name: Lilith Wyatt
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-17095
endorsements.description: A command injection vulnerability has been discovered in the bootstrap stage of Bitdefender BOX 2, versions 2.1.47.42 and 2.1.53.45. The API method `/api/download_image` unsafely handles the production firmware URL supplied by remote servers, leading to arbitrary execution of system commands. In order to exploit the condition, an unauthenticated attacker should impersonate a infrastructure server to trigger this vulnerability.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.1)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.description: A OS Command Injection vulnerability in the bootstrap stage of Bitdefender BOX 2 allows the manipulation of the `get_image_url()` function in special circumstances to inject a system command.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9)
